decisions.briefing: Markets were flat-to-slightly negative today (NASDAQ -0.4%, S&P 500 -0.1%), not the risk-on setup our strategy requires for new deployments. Several candidates (VSXY, FICO, VIST, DK, YPF, TDS) show strong MACD/RSI/SMA alignment but lack confirmed volume surge data, so we're holding our 3 open slots and $989 cash rather than forcing a buy. All 7 existing positions remain held — profit targets and stop-losses will manage them automatically.

market_education.summary_en: Major indices drifted slightly lower today with no major catalyst, reflecting a quiet, directionless session rather than any significant risk-off move. Trading volumes and momentum signals across our screened candidates were constructive but not decisively confirmed, suggesting institutional conviction hasn't fully built yet. In the absence of a clear signal, markets often consolidate before the next directional move.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大盤輕微下跌，NASDAQ跌0.4%，標普500跌0.1%，市場缺乏明確催化劑，屬於方向不明的淡靜交易日。雖然部分篩選股票的動能指標（如MACD、RSI）表現不俗，但成交量未見明顯放大，顯示資金尚未全面確認入市信號。在缺乏明確方向時，市場通常會先行整理，再等待下一波走勢。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: "Dry powder" refers to cash you keep uninvested, ready to deploy when a strong opportunity appears, rather than rushing into mediocre setups just to stay fully invested. Holding cash on a neutral day isn't a missed opportunity — it preserves flexibility and risk control for when conviction is higher.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「乾火藥」（Dry Powder）指的是投資者保留現金不急於投資，等待出現真正具吸引力的機會才出手，而不是為了「用盡資金」而勉強買入普通的標的。在市場方向不明的日子持有現金並非錯失良機，而是保留靈活性，待信號更明確時再加大力度。
